name: rcu
title: Read-copy-update
summary: Readers follow a pointer and read the record with no atomic read-modify-write and no announcement; the writer publishes a new record and waits for a grace period, until every reader has passed a quiescent state, before reusing the old one.

results.name: poisoned
results.label: Poisoned reads
results.what: reads that found a record the writer had already reused

results.name: waits
results.label: Grace-period waits
results.what: times the writer found a reader that had not yet passed a quiescent state

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of one writer and one reader, with the writer waiting for the reader's quiescent state
